basics.name: Jordan Ellery
basics.headline: Senior Data Analyst | Retail and Subscription Analytics

summary: Data analyst with 7 years in retail and subscription businesses, building reporting that finance and marketing teams use weekly. Strongest in SQL, experimentation and dashboard design. Looking for a senior analytics role where I can own metrics end to end.

bullets: Rebuilt the weekly trading dashboard in Looker, cutting report preparation from 6 hours to 45 minutes for a 12-person merchandising team.
Designed and analysed 18 A/B tests on checkout and pricing pages; two winning variants lifted conversion by 3.1% and added about 410,000 GBP annual revenue.
Created a churn-risk model in Python used by the CRM team; targeted offers reduced 90-day churn by 2.4 points.
Mentored 3 junior analysts and introduced SQL code review, reducing rework on delivered reports.
Automated 14 recurring subscription reports with Python and scheduled SQL, saving roughly 20 analyst hours per month.
Standardised customer lifetime value definitions across 3 teams, resolving a 9% discrepancy between finance and marketing figures.
Presented monthly insight reviews to the leadership team, leading to a retention campaign that grew renewals by 5%.
Maintained delivery-performance reports for 40 depots and flagged 6 recurring route delays that operations then fixed.
Cleaned and merged 5 data sources in Excel and SQL, improving report accuracy checks from monthly to daily.
